nodes.name: NF Pretreatment
nodes.procedure: Nickel foam (1 × 1.5 cm²) was pretreated with 1 M hydrochloric acid, ethanol, and ultrapure water under ultrasonic treatment, then dried in a vacuum oven.
nodes.source_text: First, Nickel foam (1 × 1.5 cm²) was pretreated with 1 M hydrochloric acid, ethanol, and ultrapure water under ultrasonic treatment, then dried in a vacuum oven.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal Synthesis of NiMoOₓ/NF
nodes.procedure: Na₂MoO₄·2H₂O (1 mmol), Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O (2 mmol), NH₄F (5 mmol), and CO(NH₂)₂ (5 mmol) were dispersed in 50 mL of mixed solvents (12 mL deionized water) and then heated at 120 °C for 6 h by hydrothermal method. After cooling to room temperature, the synthesized samples were washed several times with deionized water. Finally, dried overnight in a 70 °C vacuum oven.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD characterizes the crystalline structure of synthesized electrocatalysts. Ni-MoN-450 shows peaks at 44.5°, 51.8°, and 76.3° corresponding to (111), (200), and (220) planes of metallic Ni (PDF #97-064-6085), and peaks at 36.1°, 41.8°, 60.8°, and 72.2° indexed to (111), (200), and (220) planes of MoN (PDF#97-015-9439), indicating successful synthesis of metal nitride.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD characterizes the crystalline structure of synthesized electrocatalysts. As shown in Fig. 2a, the peaks at 44.5°, 51.8°, and 76.3°, corresponding to the (111), (200), and (220) planes metallic of Ni (PDF #97-064-6085). The other diffraction peaks at 36.1°, 41.8°, 60.8°, and 72.2°, which can be indexed to the (111), (200), and (220) planes of MoN (PDF#97-015-9439), indicating the metal nitride is successfully synthesized.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni-MoN-450 exhibits a typical two-dimensional graphene-like structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) demonstrates Ni-MoN-450 (Fig. 2b) exhibits a typical Two-dimensional graphene-like structure

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM verifies two-dimensional graphene-like morphology of Ni-MoN-450. HR-TEM shows lattice spacing of 0.214 nm and 0.2 nm indexed to Mo-N (200) and Ni (111) planes respectively.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The two-dimensional graphene-like morphology is also verified by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images (Fig. 2c). Fig. 2d and 2e show the related results, a lattice spacing of 0.214 nm and 0.2 nm can be indexed to the Mo-N (200) and Ni (111) plane respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Elemental distribution of Ni-MoN-450 demonstrates the presence of Ni, Mo and N.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Besides, the elemental distribution of Ni-MoN-450 shown in Fig. 2f-i demonstrates the presence of Ni, Mo and N in sample Ni-MoN-450.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS of Ni-MoN-450 shows total spectrum with Ni, Mo, and O; N 1s with strong Mo-N peak at 397.6 eV; Ni 2p with Ni⁰ peaks indicating partial reduction of Ni²⁺; Mo 3d with mixed Mo⁴⁺ and Mo⁶⁺ valence states, revealing interaction between Ni and Mo.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The total spectrum (Fig. 3a) indicates the existence of Ni, Mo, and O... The Ni-MoN-450 N 1 s XPS spectrum (Fig. 3b) included a significant peak attributed to Mo-N (397.6 eV)... two additional peaks corresponding to Ni⁰ are observed in Ni-MoN-450... The Mo 3d high-resolution spectra of Ni-MoN-450 shows a mixed valence state Mo⁴⁺ and Mo⁶⁺.

nodes.evidence_snippet: However, Mo-N peak is detected in the synthesized Ni-MoN-450, verifying the existence of metal nitride (Figure S4)
